outcome.Summary: Created package tmpl in tmpl/tmpl.go with Render(src, data) implementing the tiny template engine per spec: verbatim text, `{{{{` literal escape, a hand-written parser for tags (dotted names with flexible whitespace, `|`-separated filters with optional double-quoted args supporting `\"`/`\\` escapes, where quoted strings may safely contain `|` and `:`), value formatting (string/int/int64/float64/bool, nil or missing → empty), and filters upper/lower/trim/default/truncate (rune-aware, `…` not counted in N)/html. All specified error cases return a non-nil error with empty output (unknown filter, missing/extra args, bad truncate arg, unterminated tag, empty tag, bad name, indexing .field into non-map with the full dotted name in the message). Added table-driven tests (tmpl/tmpl_test.go) covering rendering, filters, chaining, and every error case; `go vet ./... && go test ./...` exits 0.
